steps.title: Open the Tapeology dashboard
steps.narration: Start by opening the main Tapeology dashboard. Here you'll find controls to select your data source and choose a ticker to watch.
steps.point_out: The header displays 'Tapeology' with a data source selection group and ticker input field visible.

steps.title: Select the Simulated data source
steps.narration: Choose Simulated mode to work with built-in market data that doesn't require external subscriptions.
steps.point_out: The 'Simulated' button is now selected, with the Ticker field ready for input.

steps.title: Enter the simulated ticker symbol
steps.narration: Type SIM-BIDABS, a built-in ticker that demonstrates how the system streams and analyzes market observations.

steps.title: Click the Watch button to start streaming
steps.narration: Press the green Watch button to begin streaming market observations for the ticker.
steps.point_out: The dashboard shows 'Watching SIM-BIDABS' with a status indicator. Within seconds, the status indicator changes to 'live' as the stream connects.

steps.title: Navigate to the Structure analysis page
steps.narration: Click the Structure link in the top navigation to view support and resistance levels and price zone analysis.
steps.point_out: The page displays the Structure heading with level and zone information as before.

steps.title: Check the Desk workspace
steps.narration: Navigate to the Desk section to view intraday market conditions and detected trading setups.
steps.point_out: The Desk page displays the trading workspace with market analysis and setup information.

steps.title: Return to the Cockpit to confirm the watch is still active
steps.narration: Click the Cockpit link to return to the main dashboard. Notice that the navigation bar has remained stable with exactly three links.
steps.point_out: The dashboard shows the active SIM-BIDABS watch, and the top navigation displays exactly three links: Cockpit, Structure, and Desk.
